name: TV/Commercial Display Production Line Solutions
summary: Turnkey automated production line solutions for TV, commercial display, education conference all-in-one, and digital signage manufacturers, covering the entire process of dispensing, lamination, flipping, inspection, bagging, and palletizing.
contentHtml:
The TV/Commercial Display Flexible Assembly Line is TXAM's turnkey automated production line solution for TV, commercial display, education conference all-in-one, and digital signage manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process of dispensing, bracket placement, lamination, flip inspection, and final bagging and palletizing, achieving fully automated production from raw materials to finished products.

Technical Advantages

  • One-click compatibility with 65~110 inch multi-size products, solving ultra-large size production challenges
  • Full-process robotic automation, greatly improving production efficiency
  • CAD import for one-click changeover, short commissioning time, minimal capacity loss
  • High line yield rate and consistent product quality
  • Self-developed WMS/WCS system, breaking information silos
  • True turnkey project with one-stop service

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service, truly delivering a turnkey project.

painPoints.title: Challenges in Large-Screen Assembly
painPoints.desc: Manual assembly of ultra-large display devices above 65 inches is difficult, inefficient, and prone to damage

painPoints.title: Complex Multi-Model Changeovers
painPoints.desc: Long changeover times and high commissioning costs for multi-model production, making flexible manufacturing difficult

painPoints.title: High Risks in Manual Flipping
painPoints.desc: Large-size product flipping relies on manual labor, posing safety hazards and risking product damage

painPoints.title: Insufficient Dispensing Precision
painPoints.desc: Traditional dispensing equipment has low precision, excessive bubbles, and cannot guarantee sealing performance

painPoints.title: Low Packaging Efficiency
painPoints.desc: The downstream packaging process is cumbersome, with high labor costs and slow cycle times for manual bagging and palletizing

painPoints.title: Severe Information Silos
painPoints.desc: No information sharing between equipment, making digital management and quality traceability difficult

process.title: Automated Dispensing
process.desc: High-precision robotic dispensing with ±0.2mm positioning accuracy and multi-nozzle matrix coordination

process.title: Precision Lamination
process.desc: Constant-pressure controlled lamination with ±0.15mm accuracy, bubble-free and misalignment-free

process.title: Safe Flipping Mechanism
process.desc: 180-degree heavy-duty flipping with one-button operation, solving large-size product flipping challenges

process.title: Visual Inspection
process.desc: AI vision system for automatic inspection, online quality control, ensuring product consistency

process.title: Automatic Bagging
process.desc: Robotic automatic bagging and packaging, saving labor and improving packaging efficiency

process.title: Intelligent Palletizing
process.desc: Six-axis robotic intelligent palletizing with ±0.5mm accuracy and 12 seconds/piece efficient palletizing

process.title: One-Click Changeover
process.desc: CAD drawing import for rapid product model changeover, greatly reducing commissioning time

process.title: Data Traceability
process.desc: WMS/WCS system enables transparent production data and full quality traceability
